note: Single switch for the admin check. false = everyone counts as admin (local game, Dave alone): X digging, NPC markers and the Admin build list just work with no admin.json or player key. A server for other players is started with --check-admin instead (same effect, this file stays false for local play); then only keys listed in data/admin.json or <store>/admin.json are admins. docs/design/ADMIN_CHECK.md.
